design_philosophy.visual_style: Dark Mode Only, Neon Accents, Sacred Geometry Overlays

headings.usage: All main headers (h1-h3), timer digits, and key metrics.

body.usage: Paragraphs, lists, form inputs, secondary text.

mono.usage: Data snippets, time stamps, code-like aesthetic elements.

backgrounds.flower_of_life: SVG overlay with opacity-10 rotation animation

hero_ring.description: Central SVG circular progress bar. Thickness: 4-6px. Glows based on current stage color.
hero_ring.animation: Pulse effect on the active tip of the ring.

milestone_icons.style: Icon inside a hexagonal border. Active state: Glows with stage color.

granite_coach_chat.avatar_style: Hexagonal mask, mystical stone face image.

time_travel_modal.style: Glassmorphism popup. Inputs look like digital clock segments.

dashboard.hero_position: col-span-12 md:col-span-6 md:col-start-4 row-span-2 flex justify-center items-center aspect-square
dashboard.stats_position: Surrounding the hero ring in bento-box style cards.

landing_page.hero: Full height 100vh. Centered 'Pathfinder DSM' logo (text). Background: Rotating Flower of Life + Particles.
landing_page.features: Zig-zag layout (Text Left/Image Right, then swapped).

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: yarn add lucide-react framer-motion tsparticles @tsparticles/react @tsparticles/slim date-fns
THEME: Ensure 'dark' class is always applied to the html element. Force dark mode.
FONTS: Import Orbitron from Google Fonts in index.css.
PARTICLES: Use tsparticles for the 'Golden Solar Flare' effect (Stage 3).
FLOWER OF LIFE: Create a 'FlowerOfLife' component using SVG. Animate rotation slowly (120s per rotation).
DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, and the hero ring.
NOISE: Add a fixed position div with pointer-events-none z-50 for a subtle film grain overlay on the whole app.
BACKEND: Update any user model to store 'fasting_start_time' and '12_laws_unlocked' array.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
